name: PTZOptics Visca

options.label: Auto tracking (PTZ Optics G3 model required)

actions.name: Custom command
actions.description: Send a command of custom bytes (with embedded parameters filled by user-defined expression) to the camera.  The camera must respond with the standard ACK + Completion response to the command or with an error.  Refer to PTZOptics VISCA over IP command documentation for command structure details.

options.label: Bytes of the command (set all parameter half-bytes to zeroes)
Parameter locations in command
options.description: The parameter list must be separated by semicolons.  Each parameter should be a comma-separated sequence of half-byte offsets into the command.  Offsets must not be reused.

notes: Complete list: 43 actions registered in src/actions/actions.ts (spread of the ten action files, no runtime-generated definitions). The module defines no feedbacks and no variables (instance.ts calls setActionDefinitions and setPresetDefinitions only). Presets (src/presets) are not catalogued because the schema has no preset field.

Transport: VISCA over IP on a TCP connection; config fields are Camera IP (required, Regex.IP), VISCA TCP port (default '5678', required) and a debugLogging checkbox (getConfigFields in src/config.ts). The module talks to PTZOptics cameras; the action list is not filtered per camera model.
Four actions have a learn callback (focusM, expM, onScreenDisplay, moveAbsolutePosition) that reads the current value from the camera with a VISCA inquiry.

Preset numbers: isValidPreset (src/camera/presets.ts:10) accepts 0 to 89 and 100 to 254; 90 to 99 and 255 are reserved by PTZOptics and rejected. PRESET_CHOICES lists exactly those 245 numeric ids (ids are numbers, labels are strings). setPreset and recallPreset have a checkbox 'isText'; when it is set the textinput presetAsText (useVariables) is parsed and must be a complete decimal number, otherwise the action logs an error and sends nothing. The textinput hint says 'Preset number range of 0-89, 100-254'. setPreset defaults to preset 253 and recallPreset to 0 (src/actions/presets.ts:310-317). speedPreset has no text mode.

moveAbsolutePosition: pan and tilt positions are numbers from 0 to 65535 (0x0000 to 0xFFFF) or, with the 'Specify ... from text' checkbox, text parsed for variables (local variables too: useVariables is { local: true } in the source, src/actions/pan-tilt.ts:128) that must evaluate to a number in the same range. Pan speed choices are 1 to 24, tilt speed choices are 1 to 20 (speedMinMax, src/actions/pan-tilt.ts:60); ids are numbers and the default for both is 12.

Pan/tilt direction actions (left, right, up, down, upLeft, upRight, downLeft, downRight, stop) have no options; they use the module-global pan/tilt speed that ptSpeedSet (1 to 24, default 12), ptSpeedU and ptSpeedD change. The module-global speed starts at 0x0c (12) and the tilt speed is capped at 0x14 (20), because 0x15 to 0x18 are valid only for panning (src/instance.ts:103-113).

irisS and shutS 'val' ids are two-digit uppercase hex strings (the VISCA parameter values). The source comment on getShutterSetting (src/actions/exposure.ts:75) notes that some shutter mappings are not exactly right on the G3 (1/180 is really 1/200, 1/90 to 1/30 are really 1/60 to 1/30). expM choice '4' (Bright Mode (manual)) carries the source comment 'Not in latest API doc: remove?'. Unknown values fall back silently: irisS to CLOSED, expM to full-auto, wb to automatic, awbS to Normal, power to On, tracking to Off.
The 'val' option of awbS has numeric ids 0, 1, 2 (default 1); wb, irisS, shutS and expM use string ids. The option id 'val' is reused with different meanings across wb, awbS, expM, irisS and shutS.

custom: 'Bytes of the command' must match /^81 ?(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{2} ?){3,13}[fF][fF]$/ (a VISCA command from 81 to FF with all parameter half-bytes set to zero); 'Parameter locations' is a semicolon-separated list of comma-separated half-byte offsets (up to four parameters, MAX_PARAMETERS_IN_COMMAND = 4); the matching parameter0 to parameter3 textinputs (useVariables) are shown only for parameters that exist and must evaluate to numbers. The command must be acknowledged by the camera with ACK and Completion.
autoTracking requires a PTZOptics G3 model according to the option label. The 'tracking' dropdown ids are 'off' and 'on'.

Built on @companion-module/base ~1.13.6: options do not support expressions. The visibleWhen entries are the isVisibleExpression strings of the source (Companion expression syntax of the module, informational). Not tested against a camera or a running Companion instance; the data comes from reading the source only.
